description: Lets Willow background agents receive and send email at a domain the owner chose (for example agents.example.com): routes the domain's mail to Amazon SES, which Willow receives it through, and publishes the domain's three Amazon SES DKIM keys.
variableDescription: %dkim1%, %dkim2%, %dkim3%: the Easy DKIM tokens Amazon SES generated for the domain (for example 3esqwbkdcckx7owabzcg437gvnnd5ir4)
